name: How long does it take to install drywall in a small bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install drywall in a small bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to install drywall in a small bathroom typically ranges from 1 to 3 days. This includes hanging the sheets, taping joints, applying multiple coats of joint compound, and sanding. Factors influencing this timeline include the bathroom's size, the complexity of the layout (e.g., numerous angles, niches), and the drying time needed between compound coats. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption while ensuring a high-quality finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing drywall in a small bathroom usually takes 1 to 3 days, depending on factors like size and complexity.
